pages.text: A [[diagonal]] cuts a rectangle into two right-angled triangles, and it is their hypotenuse. On a 4 m by 3 m floor, 4² + 3² = 25, so the diagonal is √25 = 5 m.

pages.name: A floor's diagonal
pages.task: A floor is 6 m by 2.5 m. How long is its diagonal?
pages.why: The diagonal is the hypotenuse of the right-angled triangle under it. 6² + 2.5² = 36 + 6.25 = 42.25, and √42.25 = 6.5 m.

pages.text: Straight across a 12 m by 5 m room is √(12² + 5²) = 13 m. Round two walls is 12 + 5 = 17 m. Drag the corner to try other rooms.

pages.name: A 10 m run
pages.task: Drag the corner to make a room whose straight run across, corner to corner, is 10 m.
pages.why: An 8 m by 6 m room has a straight run of √(8² + 6²) = √100 = 10 m. Round two walls it is 14 m.

pages.name: A missing side
pages.task: A straight run across a room, corner to corner, is 15 m. The room is 9 m wide. How long is it?
pages.why: The 15 m run is the hypotenuse, so the length squared is 15² − 9² = 225 − 81 = 144. √144 = 12 m.

pages.name: Between two points
pages.text: From (−1, 1) to (4, 3) is 4 − (−1) = 5 across and 2 up. Across and up meet at a right angle, so the points are √(5² + 2²) = √29, about 5.39, apart.

pages.name: A cabinet
pages.task: A steel cabinet is 40 cm wide, 40 cm deep and 70 cm tall. How far is it straight from a bottom corner to the far top corner?
pages.why: Across the floor, 40² + 40² = 3,200. That diagonal meets the 70 cm height at a right angle, so √(3,200 + 70²) = √8,100 = 90 cm.

pages.name: Square corners?
pages.task: A frame is 80 cm by 60 cm, and its diagonal measures 101 cm. Are its corners square?
pages.why: With square corners the diagonal would be √(80² + 60²) = √10,000 = 100 cm. It measures 101 cm, so the corners are not square. Pythagoras holds only for right-angled triangles.

pages.name: One unit first
pages.task: A panel is 1.2 m wide and 50 cm tall. How long is its diagonal?
pages.why: 50 cm is 0.5 m, so both sides are in metres. √(1.2² + 0.5²) = √(1.44 + 0.25) = √1.69 = 1.3 m.

pages.name: A box tank
pages.task: A box tank is 2 m long, 1 m wide and 2 m deep. How far is it straight from a bottom corner to the far top corner?
pages.why: Across the floor, 2² + 1² = 5. That diagonal meets the 2 m depth at a right angle, so √(5 + 2²) = √9 = 3 m.
